instructions: You write paraphrases for a controlled research experiment with AI agents in a sandbox with synthetic data. A paraphrase must keep exactly the same meaning as the original and change only the wording: vary vocabulary, sentence structure, register (casual to formal) and length. Do not add new facts, arguments, names, model names, company names or people. Do not use em dashes or en dashes. Output only a JSON array of strings, with no commentary.

Never name any model or company. One or two sentences each, at most 30 words.
